name: Midwest Solar Power
old_description: Midwest Solar Power LLC was founded in 2009 and brought together their backgrounds in construction, project management, and customer service to modernize the solar installation business.
about:
Founded in 2009 in Madison, Wisconsin, Midwest Solar Power LLC was started by professionals with backgrounds in construction, project management, and customer service who aimed to modernize the solar installation business.

The company provides turnkey solar installation services for residential and small commercial customers throughout Dane County and southern Wisconsin. Its offerings include roof-mounted residential systems, ground-mount arrays for sites where roof installation is not feasible, and custom commercial installations for local businesses. The team manages each project from initial consultation and site assessment through system design, permitting, installation, activation, and ongoing support.

Midwest Solar Power serves homeowners seeking to reduce energy bills and businesses looking to lower operating costs through renewable energy. Commercial clients include small businesses in the Madison area that want tailored solar solutions designed to maximize investment and environmental impact. The company also assists customers with navigating incentives such as the federal 30% investment tax credit and emerging programs like the Home Energy Assistance Rebate (HEAR) program.

The firm distinguishes itself by emphasizing honest, high-quality work at a fair price and by treating each installation as unique, requiring a deep understanding of how the solar array interacts with the existing structure. This approach, combined with a full-service process from consultation to post-installation support, is intended to deliver a hassle-free transition to sustainable energy for every client.
